name: Youth Service Corps (Allen Neighborhood Center)
what_you_do: Take part in a youth-led job and life skill program run by a neighborhood center in Lansing.
pay_detail: Free. Teens may get gift cards for their service.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 sessions meet Mondays, 3:30 to 5 p.m. Start and end dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the YSC Registration Form. Send it to davidm@allenneighborhoodcenter.org. That is David McCarthy, who manages programs for all ages. You can also call (517) 999-3913.
